title: Expert overview
summary: What needs a busy person on one quiet page: at most three plain sentences, one line per app, done folded, and one app's four-step track.
purpose: The registry block's ExpertOverview and ExpertTrack as an app mounts them, over plain data and no network. « For you » passes five items and the block shows the first three, each a quiet sentence with one gesture (a question has a gesture and a « Later »), then one line per app and « Done » folded. « Track » shows one app's four steps and one row per feature, each said in words and drawn in four segments. « Calm » is the page when nothing needs the person. No box, badge, count or red anywhere; every sentence, count and day is the app's.

fixture.usage: <ExpertOverview heading="Good evening" intro="Two small things." needsYou={items} apps={apps} done={done} />

notes: Nothing scrolls sideways at 390 px; every gesture is at least 44 px high on a phone; text reads at 4.5:1 or better in light and dark (the tokens do it: no dark: class in the block). The block shows three items at most, whatever it is given; « Later » on a question hands its place to the next item, which the app decides, not the block.
